context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 215bb transparency bug fix VERIFIED. The root cause was missing shadcn HSL tokens (--background, --card, --popover, etc.) which caused bg-background to render as transparent. Fix adds these tokens at :root (light defaults) and [data-theme='dark'] (dark overrides). Pulse safety net verified - no leakage of GymAxis styling to Pulse pages.
